tool_args.rationale: The seven paid rows span the u_now range and include two widely separated s_grad values. They support fitting a low-complexity, smooth concave response with a gradient correction; the pilot and acquired measurements show no chaotic sign oscillation. The open-branch probe has resolved the main ambiguity sufficiently to author a numerically fitted model rather than buy another batch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired low/high s_grad rows already test the gradient branch; a larger batch is not yet justified before fitting this compact model.
The observed response remains increasing across the sampled u_now range, so high-u inhibition is not supported by these rows.
The response is visibly concave in u_now, while an additive saturating-plus-square-root term also represents the observed shape and can account for gradient variation.
It is irrelevant to identifying the measured response law and should not be purchased.
